pages.text: Every citizen needs a $(thing)home$(0) suited to its class. A newcomer is content with a rough shelter; a higher class expects a larger, better-appointed house before it will call the place home.$(br2)Because homes are per-class, upgrading a citizen means upgrading its housing too — build a little finer each time someone is ready to rise.

A home only has to meet its class's $(thing)requirements$(0) — the size and comforts that class expects. You can stick to those rules and keep houses as simple as possible if you like.$(br2)But you are always free to $(thing)decorate$(0)! Add any details you please over the required blocks — flourishes never hurt a home, and a lovingly built city is its own reward.
$(italic)Housing specifics — exact room sizes and required fittings per class — will be documented here once the structures are finalised.$(0)
